examined_formations.title: CHINA_MAINLAND_CLOUD_MIGRATION_ICP_ACCESS_FILING_CONTROL
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国大陆云迁移后的 ICP 接入备案与上线控制
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A January 2026 Chinese participant was pulled into a project after a team moved an already-filed domain from Alibaba Cloud to ByteDance/Volcengine infrastructure and initially diagnosed the failure as nginx or port configuration.

After temporary reachability changes, Volcengine displayed that the domain had not completed filing/access with Volcengine; the participant's original access-filing diagnosis proved operationally relevant.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The organization already owns the domain and an existing ICP filing number, but deployment on a new mainland access provider requires the filing record to be associated with the actual access provider.

Volcengine's current documentation states that a site already filed through another provider must complete access filing when its domain is pointed to a Volcengine mainland server; without the corresponding provider access filing the domain is treated as unfiled on that platform.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The team spent engineering time changing ports and reverse-proxy assumptions before the provider-side access rule became the decisive blocker.
The practical route is not a code fix: the responsible organization must submit identity/entity/site information through the actual access provider and wait for the provider/regulatory filing path.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is a genuine non-generic control surface because an ordinary coding agent cannot make a mainland access provider recognize a domain as properly filed merely by changing DNS or nginx.

However the control right belongs to the access provider and communications-administration process, and Volcengine itself offers filing submission plus paid filing-assistance services; a new generic operator cannot independently grant the access status.
economic_signal: The control failure can block a production site after infrastructure migration and therefore has direct availability and migration-cost consequences.

No evidence shows recurring normalized willingness to pay for an independent control owner distinct from the cloud provider's own filing tooling or assistance; the observed spend is primarily cloud migration and engineering time.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Volcengine documents access filing as mandatory when an already-filed website/App moves to its mainland hosting and states that business cannot be conducted on the platform until the corresponding access filing is completed.
Volcengine also sells filing-assistance services that help submit the filing application to the access service provider, so even the administrative support layer is already provider-native.

Alibaba Cloud publishes the same provider-association model for domains moving onto Alibaba Cloud mainland servers, confirming that the control surface is structurally tied to the actual access provider rather than an independent generic intermediary.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_APPLE_DEVELOPER_ORGANIZATION_IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_AND_DISTRIBUTION_RIGHT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国组织 Apple Developer 身份验证、会员注册与分发权
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A June 2026 Chinese participant documented repeated Apple Developer organization-enrollment failures across region settings, web versus Developer App flow, payment attempts, work-domain email entry and account blocking, followed by several support contacts and escalation.

The participant ultimately completed the process through another Apple account after supplying the responsible person's identity documents, the applicant's employment proof, business license and D-U-N-S information.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The organization controls its app, legal entity documents and employees, but it does not control Apple Developer Program identity verification, seller status or App Store distribution membership.

Apple currently requires a legal entity, D-U-N-S number, binding authority, organization-domain work email and public website for organization enrollment, with additional identity or notarized business documents possible.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The participant changed account region, obtained D-U-N-S data, switched enrollment channels, contacted support multiple times, appealed, used another Apple account and uploaded corporate/identity evidence before enrollment progressed.
Those actions show a real state transition whose bottleneck is platform identity trust and contractual eligibility rather than app code.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: A trusted enrollment/identity concierge could reduce preparation errors and workflow confusion, but it cannot independently create Apple contractual eligibility, D-U-N-S verification or binding authority.

The final right is explicitly granted by Apple after verification and membership purchase, so the strongest control surface is upstream-owned; any independent service remains guidance/document coordination rather than the principal right.
economic_signal: The participant incurred several days of delay, support effort and failed payment/enrollment attempts for a channel directly tied to shipping software through the App Store.
Apple's membership fee is current direct spend on the upstream program, not evidence of willingness to pay an independent operator; no separate recurring external operator payment is evidenced.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Apple's current enrollment documentation requires legal-entity status, D-U-N-S, legal binding authority, work-domain email and a functioning organization website.

Apple's current identity-verification documentation specifically states that mainland-China Account Holders require identity verification and that organizations may be asked for additional notarized business documents.

Dun & Bradstreet controls the D-U-N-S business identifier while Apple controls program verification and membership, leaving no independent small operator with authority to grant the distribution right.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_CROSS_CARRIER_CONSUMER_PARCEL_PICKUP_DATA_AGGREGATION_RIGHT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国消费者跨快递/驿站取件信息聚合与手机号查件数据权
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A June 2026 Chinese participant reported that a Taobao order showed delivery into a Fengchao locker but did not display the pickup code unless the user authorized Fengchao; the participant refused that authorization and obtained the code only after courier customer service resent it by SMS.

A November 2025 Chinese developer separately described wanting a single app that, after phone-number authorization, could pull all parcels across Cainiao and Pinduoduo pickup stations because YTO parcels had moved to a different station ecosystem and the available API path did not provide that consumer-wide aggregation.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The consumer controls their phone number and purchase relationship, yet parcel/pickup data is split among ecommerce platforms, carriers, lockers and station networks, so user possession of the phone number alone does not yield a universal machine-readable parcel graph.

Kuaidi100's current API documentation exposes phone-number parcel lookup as a cooperation model in which logistics service providers provide the query interface to Kuaidi100, and its carrier-onboarding documentation references a signed phone-query data-use authorization.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Consumers fall back to platform authorization, multiple apps, SMS, station/locker interfaces or courier customer service to recover pickup information.

The developer attempted to identify an API-based aggregation path rather than merely proposing a UI, but the decisive missing asset is cross-provider phone-to-parcel data access rather than frontend implementation.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is the strongest Scan 100 example of a potentially reusable data-control asset: bilateral carrier/station data relationships can reveal parcels that a generic agent cannot infer from a phone number alone.

However Kuaidi100 already operates a carrier-partnership layer for phone-based parcel lookup, while consumer platforms and pickup networks own their own segments; a new small operator would need many sensitive-data agreements before coverage becomes useful.

Without those agreements the residual path collapses to user-authorized app access, notification/SMS parsing or manual customer-service retrieval, which is incomplete and substantially generic-agent substitutable.
economic_signal: The participant evidence proves repeated convenience and retrieval friction, and the 2025 developer evidence proves active implementation interest.

No current participant-level payment or recurring business cost is evidenced for a universal consumer parcel aggregator, so the value jump is not yet bound to normalized external economics even before the multi-carrier data-rights burden.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Kuaidi100 currently documents phone-number parcel lookup as a business cooperation where the logistics provider supplies a phone-query interface and the parties protect the resulting user parcel information.

Its API documentation and carrier-onboarding materials require enterprise authorization and, for phone-based lookup cooperation, a signed data-use authorization; this confirms that the decisive data graph is contractually controlled rather than an open public endpoint.
Kuaidi100 also operates enterprise parcel-query products and carrier integrations, while Cainiao, Pinduoduo pickup networks, lockers and carriers each control portions of the consumer pickup flow.
